events.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Competition and Puzzle Swap

cases.refreshed: Are you a dissectologist? Do you love the assembly of jigsaw puzzles? Join our adult puzzle competition! 10 teams of 4 people each, 2 hours, 500 pieces, and bragging rights. Each team receives the same 500-piece puzzle. No one gets to see the puzzle until the timer begins. The goal is to be the team that finishes the jigsaw puzzle in the shortest amount of time. If no team is finished at the 2-hour mark, the winning team will be the one with the fewest remaining loose pieces. Ages 14+. For the puzzle swap, please bring puzzles with no missing pieces. Online registration is required, starting Sunday, October 25 at 10 AM. Event capacity is 40 people. You may sign up in groups of four, or as individuals. This event is sponsored by The Friends of the Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.

cases.refreshed: Come practice your reading skills and read aloud to a friendly dog or cat -- your very own furry audience! You can bring a book from home or borrow one from the Children's Room. This program is perfect for emergent readers. Children in grades K-8 are welcome to participate. Online registration for 10-minute sessions opens Wednesday, November 25 at 8:00 AM. Reserve spots only for children who will participate. When you register, provide each child's name and a parent's email address. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: The concert is on Tuesday, December 1 at 7 PM in Room 201. Bel Canto Flutes is an all-flute ensemble featuring flutes of all shapes and sizes. Bel Canto Flutes enjoys showing off the beauty and flexibility of the flute with repertoire that spans the ages and genres. Our program for you will feature melodies both familiar and new with anecdotes about the music, its composers, and its origins. Come join us as we share our joy of music making with you. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.

events.title: Create CU: Jumbo Bookmarks and Open Studio

cases.refreshed: Friday, December 11 at 7 PM in Room 201. Join us for more creative exploration with art materials. Bring your unfinished artwork, sketchbook or journal and your curiosity. Or try the evening's prompt and make a 3 x 9 mixed-media jumbo bookmark with acrylic paint, collage, pens, markers, and more. Supplies will be provided, but you can bring your own art journal or favorite supplies. Online registration opens November 28, 2026, at 10 AM. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. events.title: Create Cu: Sgraffito using oil pastels

cases.refreshed: Sgraffito is a form of decoration or drawing made by scratching through a surface to reveal a lower layer of a contrasting color. Although it is often considered a ceramic technique, we will be using oil pastels on paper. Online registration will open Friday, October 23 at 10 AM. All artistic supplies and instruction will be provided. This class is for adults aged eighteen and older. Sponsored by The Friends of the Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.
